# Anne Shirley & Julia Bell

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md) — schoolmates who exchange friendly tokens · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a dramatic goodbye, explaining that her mother forbids them from playing together, though the two exchange promises of eternal friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and secretly exchanges notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) despite their enforced separation. Driven by a lingering grudge, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) throws herself into her studies to compete academically against [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), making impressive progress alongside him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the encouraging guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically discusses her school activities and composition writing with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly prepares her recitations and roles despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's quiet support.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> As life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into a routine after the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and walks along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), discussing her birthday, a fictional story she wrote, and the idea of forming a story club. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains the newly formed story club to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who scoffs at the endeavor as a foolish waste of time while reminding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to focus on her chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed
